content: Always consult your healthcare professional for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs. If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services immediately (911 in the U.S.). For less severe cases, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Laboratory and/or medical tests, such as a complete blood count or kidney function tests, may be required while using this medication. Ensure that you attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. It is crucial to take each dose of this medication as prescribed. If you miss a dose, consult your doctor or pharmacist promptly to establish a new dosing schedule. For storage instructions, refer to the product guidelines or consult your pharmacist. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last updated in August 2024. Please note that this is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your use. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always seek the guidance of your healthcare professional for complete and individualized information about this product and your health needs. Adding plans allows you to compare formulary status with other drugs in the same class. To view formulary information, first create a list of plans. Your list will be saved and can be edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the relevant plan provider for the most up-to-date information. If you are sending information to a recipient, they will receive further details and instructions to access the offer.
